claims.text: AWS's Aug 20 blog states Policy Authoring turns natural-language documents into Dogwood/Cedar policies with validation against tool schemas and over/under-permissiveness checks.
Enforcement is described at the gateway layer, outside agent code, with deterministic deny-by-default decisions and logging.
claims.context: Architecture description; 'prompt-proof' reading is not adopted beyond the text.
